unsupported: Origin serves food and beverage brands seeking private-label dairy and functional-food solutions, as well as companies needing contract packing for nutritional products.

Its customer base includes marketers of on-the-go health foods, retailers building store-brand yogurt lines, and nutrition-focused brands requiring specific functional benefits such as digestive health, bone support, or cholesterol management.

Known for: First in its home country to launch Swiss-style drinkable and spoonable yogurt; Every product fortified with added vitamins, minerals, and supplements; Premium ingredients such as HOWARU® probiotics, TruCal® calcium, and Benecol®; Specific functional benefits including cholesterol reduction and anemia prevention; All products developed and produced in-house at the Statesville, NC facility; Milk sourced locally from Stamey Farms
